title: Sharp positivity orders for reduction maps on perfect-tensor codes
author: Lluis Eriksson

technical_quality.basis: Complete analytic reconstruction, complex conjugations and output privacy, incident-star certificate, boundary/rank cases, sharp analytic witnesses and exact controls.

importance_airr.basis: Substantive exact classification and optimal uniform orders in rigid AME code sectors; no unrestricted Werner conclusion, new code construction, general EB criterion or tensor stability from mere k-positivity.

correctness_confidence.basis: Universal proof reconstructed and exact adversarial checks; one model and no formal/human independent verification.

rigor_and_completeness.basis: Hypotheses, complex Gram, mixed blocks, endpoints and witnesses covered; appendix compact but reconstructible.

novelty_relative_to_checked_sources.basis: Specific combination not found duplicated in examined primary passages; classical ingredients and bounded search acknowledged.

significance_if_correct.basis: Uniform sharp rank classification in nontrivial coded families, with substantial support restrictions and no unrestricted application proved.

reproducibility_inspectability.basis: Portable author supplement, preserved historical failures, independent implementation, input and archive hashes.

optional_comments.comment: State explicitly that k is a positive integer; the standard convention is correctly used.
Optional regime table separating the five-copy all-t minimum from the rank classification only at t=1/2.
Optional pinpoint citation to Helwig Fig2(d), Theorem7 and section4.3.

scope_limits: Existence of AME is a hypothesis except explicit constructions.
Entire row or image support must be contained in the code.
Five-copy rank classification is at t=1/2, not all t.
Tensorization applies only to CP regimes.
No unrestricted rank-two Werner positivity or undistillability follows.
No universal priority or exhaustive literature claim.
